2026 State General Election is Coming Up  
2026 State General Election is Coming Up on November 3rd 
Posted on 10/05/2026 
N.H. State General Elections are coming up on Tuesday November 3 rd . As usual, voting in Wilton will be from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the Wilton Town Hall. 
Below you will find links to a sample ballot, and a form to request an absentee ballot.
